metadata.name: tipoff
metadata.description: Tipoff: insider-trading deduction game on MagicBlock Ephemeral Rollups

instructions.name: cash_out
docs: Returns a player's profile to Solana. The player must have left their seat.

instructions.name: checkpoint
docs: Commits the table to Solana and records the round there through a Magic Action.

instructions.name: init_player
docs: Creates the player's profile and registers the session key that will sign on the rollup.

instructions.name: init_table
docs: Creates a table and its hidden `Secret`. `salt_commit` seeds the hidden entropy chain.

instructions.name: on_random
docs: VRF callback. Draws the insider and the shocks into hidden state and opens the round.

instructions.name: record_round
docs: Magic Action target: runs on Solana with the table commit and records the round.

instructions.name: seal_seat
docs: Seals one seat's private account before anyone sits.

instructions.name: seal_secret
docs: Seals the `Secret`: private, with no members. Nobody can read it, the operator included.

instructions.name: settle
docs: Closes the round: marks positions, unseals the insider, shocks and votes, and scores.

instructions.name: sit
docs: Takes an empty seat. Only this player's wallet and session key may read the seat's
private account from now on. Without a profile the signer plays as a guest: its key is
both wallet and session key, and nothing has to exist on Solana first.

instructions.name: stand
docs: Leaves a seat between rounds. With a profile, the seat's score is banked into it.

instructions.name: start_round
docs: Requests randomness for the next round. Anyone may call once every seat is filled.

instructions.name: tick
docs: Refreshes the public price from the oracle and the hidden shocks. Anyone, or a crank.

instructions.name: trade
docs: Buys (`delta > 0`) or sells (`delta < 0`) lots at the current price. No fees.

instructions.name: vote
docs: Casts or changes a sealed accusation. Only the voter can read it until settlement.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Signer is not this seat's wallet or session key

errors.name: BadSecret
errors.msg: Secret does not match this round

errors.name: BadPrice
errors.msg: Price feed is invalid or stale

errors.name: AlreadyVoted
errors.msg: This seat has already voted this round

types.name: Ledger
docs: Lives on Solana and is never delegated; written by the checkpoint Magic Action.

types.name: Print
docs: One print on the public trade tape.

fields.name: pos
docs: Lots held this round; negative is short.

fields.name: cash
docs: Chips paid and received this round; after settlement, the round's trading result.

fields.name: last
docs: Score from the last settled round.

fields.name: score
docs: Score across rounds at this table.

types.name: SeatPrivate
docs: Readable only by the player in this seat.

fields.name: shocks
docs: The round's shocks, filled only for the insider.

types.name: Secret
docs: Hidden for the whole round: private with no members.

types.name: Shock
docs: A news shock: `bps` is added to the price `at` seconds into the round.

types.name: Table
docs: Public table state. Everything here is readable by anyone.

fields.name: open_price
docs: Oracle SOL/USD at the open, 8 decimals.

fields.name: price
docs: Oracle price with every shock so far applied.

fields.name: entropy
docs: Public entropy mixed in from every player who sits.
